import requests, numpy as np, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import defaultdict
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.patches as mpatch

rawm="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -2 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
ls=rawm.strip().split("\n"); cols=ls[0].split(); B62={}
for l in ls[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): B62[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return B62.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): X[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1)
    for j in range(1,m+1): Y[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=sc(s1[i-1],s2[j-1])
            o=[M[i-1,j-1]+s,X[i-1,j-1]+s,Y[i-1,j-1]+s]; k=int(np.argmax(o)); M[i,j]=o[k]; pM[i,j]=k
            o=[M[i-1,j]+go,X[i-1,j]+ge,Y[i-1,j]+go]; k=int(np.argmax(o)); X[i,j]=o[k]; pX[i,j]=k
            o=[M[i,j-1]+go,X[i,j-1]+go,Y[i,j-1]+ge]; k=int(np.argmax(o)); Y[i,j]=o[k]; pY[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]])); a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]); a2.append(s2[j-1]); ns=pM[i,j]; i-=1; j-=1
        elif st==1: a1.append(s1[i-1]); a2.append("-"); ns=pX[i,j]; i-=1
        else: a1.append("-"); a2.append(s2[j-1]); ns=pY[i,j]; j-=1
        if i==0 and j>0: st=2; continue
        if j==0 and i>0: st=1; continue
        st=ns
    return "".join(a1[::-1]),"".join(a2[::-1])
t2o=dict(zip("ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL MSE".split(),
             "ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYVM"))
txt=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/6VME.pdb",timeout=120).text
A6=[(l[21],int(l[22:26]),float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]))
    for l in txt.split("\n") if l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")) and l[17:20].strip() in t2o and l[16] in (" ","A") and l[76:78].strip()!="H"]
prot={}
for c in "BFGHIJ": prot[c]="TSG101"
for c in "CKLMNO": prot[c]="VPS37B"
for c in "ADPQRT": prot[c]="MVB12A"
for c in "EUVWXY": prot[c]="VPS28"
arr=np.array([[a[2],a[3],a[4]] for a in A6]); pr=np.array([prot[a[0]] for a in A6]); rr=np.array([a[1] for a in A6])
qi=np.where(pr=="MVB12A")[0]
nburied=defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
for part in ["TSG101","VPS37B","VPS28"]:
    oi=np.where(pr==part)[0]
    d=np.linalg.norm(arr[qi][:,None,:]-arr[oi][None,:,:],axis=2)
    for a,b in np.argwhere(d<4.5): nburied[int(rr[qi[a]])][part]+=1
IF=set(nburied)
def fa(a): return "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
REG={"MVB12A":("Q96EY5",196,273),"MVB12B":("Q9H7P6",235,312),"UBAP1":("Q9NZ09",1,75),"UMAD1":("C9J7I0",66,137)}
seq={k:fa(v[0]) for k,v in REG.items()}
sub={k:(seq[k][v[1]-1:v[2]],v[1]) for k,v in REG.items()}
ref_s,ref_off=sub["MVB12A"]
rows={}
for q in ["MVB12B","UBAP1","UMAD1"]:
    a,b=nw(ref_s,sub[q][0]); i=ref_off-1; j=sub[q][1]-1; mm={}
    for x,y in zip(a,b):
        if x!="-": i+=1
        if y!="-": j+=1
        if x!="-": mm[i]=(y, j if y!="-" else None)
    rows[q]=mm
stat={}
for q in ["MVB12B","UBAP1","UMAD1"]:
    ib=[];ob=[];ii=[];oo=[]
    for r in range(204,274):
        aa=ref_s[r-ref_off]; y=rows[q].get(r,("-",None))[0]
        s=sc(aa,y) if y!="-" else -6; idt=1 if (y==aa and y!="-") else 0
        (ib if r in IF else ob).append(s); (ii if r in IF else oo).append(idt)
    U,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(ib,ob,alternative="greater")
    stat[q]=dict(ii=np.mean(ii),oi=np.mean(oo),ib=np.mean(ib),ob=np.mean(ob),p=p,cles=U/(len(ib)*len(ob)))
# AlphaFold
def af(acc):
    j=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}",timeout=120).json()[0]
    pdb=requests.get(j["pdbUrl"],timeout=120).text
    return {int(l[22:26]):float(l[60:66]) for l in pdb.split("\n") if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"}
PL={k:af(v) for k,v in {"UMAD1":"C9J7I0","MVB12A":"Q96EY5","MVB12B":"Q9H7P6","UBAP1":"Q9NZ09"}.items()}

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(17,10))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,3,height_ratios=[1.35,1,1],hspace=0.62,wspace=0.3)
axA=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
res_range=list(range(204,224)); names=["MVB12A","MVB12B","UBAP1","UMAD1"]
for xi,r in enumerate(res_range):
    aa=ref_s[r-ref_off]; nb=sum(nburied[r].values()) if r in nburied else 0
    axA.add_patch(mpatch.Rectangle((xi,3.55),1,0.42,color=plt.cm.Greys(min(nb/200,1.0)),ec="white"))
    for yi,q in enumerate(names):
        if q=="MVB12A": y_,jn=aa,r
        else: y_,jn=rows[q].get(r,("-",None))
        col="#2a7a3b" if y_==aa else ("#9fd4a8" if (y_!="-" and sc(aa,y_)>0) else ("#e8e8e8" if y_!="-" else "#ffffff"))
        axA.add_patch(mpatch.Rectangle((xi,3.0-yi*0.75),1,0.7,color=col,ec="white"))
        axA.text(xi+0.5,3.35-yi*0.75,y_,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=11,
                 color="white" if y_==aa else "black",fontweight="bold" if y_==aa else "normal")
    axA.text(xi+0.5,4.12,str(r),ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=7,rotation=90)
for yi,q in enumerate(names): axA.text(-0.3,3.35-yi*0.75,q,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=10)
axA.text(-0.3,3.76,"ESCRT-I contact atoms",ha="right",va="center",fontsize=8)
axA.set_xlim(-6.5,len(res_range)); axA.set_ylim(-0.3,4.7); axA.axis("off")
axA.set_title("A  ESCRT-I headpiece contact segment of MVB12A (PDB 6VME, 2.19 A) aligned to MVB12B, UBAP1 and UMAD1.\n"
              "Dark green: identical to MVB12A. Light green: BLOSUM62 positive. Grey: non-conservative. Residue numbers are MVB12A.",
              fontsize=11,loc="left")
axA.annotate("V-P-F-T-L anchor identical in UMAD1 (V89-L93)",xy=(16.5,2.95),xytext=(13.5,4.45),fontsize=9,ha="center",
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",lw=1.2))
axA.annotate("MVB12A D216 is S87 in UMAD1",xy=(12.5,0.6),xytext=(7.5,-0.15),fontsize=9,ha="center",
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",lw=1.2))
qs=["MVB12B","UBAP1","UMAD1"]; x=np.arange(3); w=0.36
axB=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
axB.bar(x-w/2,[100*stat[q]["ii"] for q in qs],w,label="ESCRT-I interface (n=19)",color="#2a7a3b")
axB.bar(x+w/2,[100*stat[q]["oi"] for q in qs],w,label="rest of region (n=51)",color="#b9b9b9")
for i,q in enumerate(qs): axB.text(i,max(100*stat[q]['ii'],100*stat[q]['oi'])+3,f"p={stat[q]['p']:.3f}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
axB.set_xticks(x); axB.set_xticklabels(qs); axB.set_ylabel("identity to MVB12A (%)"); axB.set_ylim(0,80)
axB.legend(fontsize=8); axB.set_title("B  Interface positions conserved\npreferentially in UMAD1",fontsize=10,loc="left")
axC=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
axC.bar(x-w/2,[stat[q]["ib"] for q in qs],w,color="#2a7a3b"); axC.bar(x+w/2,[stat[q]["ob"] for q in qs],w,color="#b9b9b9")
axC.axhline(0,color="k",lw=0.8); axC.set_xticks(x); axC.set_xticklabels(qs); axC.set_ylabel("mean BLOSUM62 score")
axC.set_title("C  Substitution quality,\ninterface vs background",fontsize=10,loc="left")
axD=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,2])
UMA={"UMAD1":(86,134),"MVB12A":(215,265),"MVB12B":(254,303),"UBAP1":(17,63)}
cl={"UMAD1":"#c0392b","MVB12A":"#2c3e50","MVB12B":"#2980b9","UBAP1":"#8e44ad"}
for k in names:
    d=PL[k]; a0,b0=UMA[k]
    xs=[r-a0 for r in sorted(d) if a0<=r<=b0]; ys=[d[r] for r in sorted(d) if a0<=r<=b0]
    axD.plot(xs,ys,label=f"{k} {a0}-{b0}",color=cl[k],lw=1.6)
axD.axhline(70,ls="--",color="grey",lw=1)
axD.set_xlabel("position within UMA domain"); axD.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT"); axD.legend(fontsize=7)
axD.set_title("D  UMA domain order in\nAlphaFold monomer models",fontsize=10,loc="left")
axE=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,:2]); bot=np.zeros(len(res_range))
for part,c in [("TSG101","#34495e"),("VPS37B","#e67e22"),("VPS28","#16a085")]:
    v=np.array([nburied[r].get(part,0) for r in res_range])
    axE.bar(range(len(res_range)),v,bottom=bot,color=c,label=part); bot+=v
lbl=[]
for r in res_range:
    aa=ref_s[r-ref_off]; u=rows["UMAD1"].get(r,("-",None))
    lbl.append(f"{aa}{r}\n{u[0]}{u[1] if u[1] else ''}")
axE.set_xticks(range(len(res_range))); axE.set_xticklabels(lbl,fontsize=7.5)
axE.set_ylabel("contact atom pairs < 4.5 A\n(6 copies in 6VME)"); axE.legend(fontsize=8)
axE.set_title("E  Per-residue ESCRT-I contacts of MVB12A (upper label) with the aligned UMAD1 residue (lower label)",fontsize=10,loc="left")
axF=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,2])
par=["VPS37A","VPS37C","VPS37D"]; xp=np.arange(3)
axF.bar(xp-w/2,[60,70,50],w,color="#e67e22",label="UMA-contact surface (n=10)")
axF.bar(xp+w/2,[35,44,40],w,color="#d9d9d9",label="full length")
axF.set_xticks(xp); axF.set_xticklabels(par); axF.set_ylabel("identity to VPS37B (%)"); axF.set_ylim(0,85); axF.legend(fontsize=7.5)
axF.set_title("F  UMA-contact surface conserved\nin all four VPS37 paralogs",fontsize=10,loc="left")

for q in qs: print(f"{q}: iface id {100*stat[q]['ii']:.0f}% vs bg {100*stat[q]['oi']:.0f}%; BLOSUM {stat[q]['ib']:+.2f} vs {stat[q]['ob']:+.2f}; MWU p={stat[q]['p']:.4f}; CLES={stat[q]['cles']:.2f}")
